project.name: F998 Live Sound Card Study And Integration Plan
project.objective: Create a source-linked, reproducible setup guide for the F998 portable streaming audio interface and live sound card.

device.fcc_identified_manufacturer: Shenzhen Furuijie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
device.category: portable live sound card, microphone processor, and streaming audio interface

goals: Confirm the physical port labels and retail revision from the actual unit.
Build reliable microphone, accompaniment, headphone monitoring, and computer/phone streaming paths.
Use Ubuntu only after observing ALSA and PipeWire endpoint behavior.
Keep keyboard line-level mixing on the TEYUN A8 unless the F998 input range is measured and documented.
